h1: CNC tube benders — electric, hybrid and hydraulic mandrel benders
intro: A CNC tube bender feeds, rotates and bends the tube from a program, so a part with ten bends in different planes comes off the machine the same every time; a mandrel inside the tube and a wiper die keep thin walls round at tight radii. NovoTech sells two makers' CNC mandrel benders in Canada, all on this page, small to large: CSM of Tainan, Taiwan — the EMB / EMR all-electric benders that switch between left- and right-hand bending within one part, from Ø19/32″ brake and fuel line to Ø3″, and the all-electric MRE2-RBE to Ø4″; the TBRE / TMRE / TSRE / TDRE and MBE / MRE electric hybrids from Ø15/32″ to Ø6″ with one to three stacked tools and roll-bending heads; and the TSR / TDR hydraulic CNC pipe benders to Ø8-5/8″ — then ISITAN of Bursa, Turkey: the five-axis SFB CNC/A5 with servo roll-bending for large sweeps, Ø1-1/2″ to Ø2-1/2″, and the SFB CNC/A3 in five sizes from Ø1-1/2″ tube to Ø3-1/2″ × 8 ga pipe, both with a 21″ touchscreen CNC, 3D simulation and spring-back compensation. Each family below has its full specification table and photos. Every machine comes with a CSA-approved panel, tooling, installation and training, supported from Mississauga, ON, Canada. NC mandrel benders, which program the bend angles while the tube is fed by hand or by a carrier, are on the NC page.

faq.a: All-electric (EMB / EMR, MRE2-RBE): every axis is a servo motor — no oil, no warm-up, lower energy use, quiet and the most repeatable; the choice for small tube in high volume — fuel and brake lines, HVAC, head-rest bars, furniture. Electric hybrid (MBE / MRE and the T series): servo bend arm, carriage and collet for accuracy, hydraulic clamp, pressure die and mandrel for force — the usual production bender from Ø1/2″ to Ø6″. Hydraulic CNC (TSR / TDR): a hydraulic bend arm for heavy wall and large pipe to Ø8-5/8″ — boiler, shipyard, construction and water-supply pipe. NC (TSRJ / TDRJ, TNCPB, TNCB): PLC control and a lower price where the parts are simpler or the batches smaller.

faq.q: How many stacked tools do I need, and what is roll bending?
faq.a: Each stacked tool is another bend die (radius) on the same head; the head shifts up / down and left / right between them, so a part with two or three radii is bent in one cycle without a die change. One tool (TSRE, TSR, TNCB) suits single-radius parts; two (TDRE, TDR, TBRE) or three (MBE / MRE, TMRE) furniture, automotive and exhaust parts with several radii; the EMB / EMR carry 3 + 3, for left- and right-hand bends. A roll-bending head (EMR, MRE, TBRE / TMRE, MRE2-RBE) rolls large and variable radii — arcs, coils and frames — without a die for every radius.

faq.q: What does a rear booster do?
faq.a: It pushes the tube from behind while the bend arm draws it around the die, so the outside wall thins less and the inside wall does not wrinkle — the way to bend thin-wall tube and pipe to radii down to about 1 × D (boiler pipe on the 120 TNCB-RBF, for example). -RBE is a servo booster on the electric and hybrid benders; -RBF, -RBH and -CBF are hydraulic boosters on the hydraulic machines.

Yes: bundle loaders that feed the tube to the carriage, punching units on the head for holes in furniture tube (the P versions), an integrated circular saw that cuts each part off the bar, end-forming stations, robot transfer and checking fixtures. The videos under each series show most of them in production, and we lay out the cell for your parts.

faq.q: How do I read a CSM model name?
faq.a: The number is the largest round tube in millimetres: a 38 TDRE bends Ø1-1/2″ (38.1 mm), an 80 MBE Ø3-1/8″ (80 mm), a 220 TNCB Ø8-5/8″ pipe. The letters name the series — EMB / EMR all-electric, MBE / MRE and the TBRE / TMRE / TSRE / TDRE electric hybrids, TSR / TDR hydraulic CNC, TSRJ / TDRJ, TNCPB and TNCB NC — and in the T series S, D and M stand for one, two and three stacked tools. The suffix names the booster: -RBE a servo rear booster, -RBF, -RBH and -CBF hydraulic boosters.

Both ISITAN CNC benders have servo feed (Y), rotation (B) and bend (C). The A5 adds two servo roll-bending axes, so one machine can draw-bend tight radii around the mandrel and roll-bend large-radius sweeps — handrail returns, roll cages, furniture arcs — without changing machines or tooling. If every bend in your parts is a tight radius, the A3 does the job.

faq.q: Does it bend without a mandrel too?
faq.a: Yes — every SFB CNC bends with or without the mandrel, selected in the program. Thick-wall tube and generous radii bend without; thin-wall tube and tight radii need the mandrel (and often a wiper die) to stop wrinkling and collapse.

faq.q: Can I program from a drawing?
faq.a: The CNC takes X-Y-Z coordinates from the part drawing and converts them to Y-B-C bender data (feed, rotation, bend), simulates the sequence in 3D with collision warning, and estimates the tube length and cycle time before you bend the first part.

Both are mandrel benders sold, installed and supported by NovoTech. The ISITAN SFB benders (Turkey) cover Ø1-1/4″ to Ø3-1/2″ with NC and CNC models for the job shop and fabricator. CSM covers a far wider range — from Ø15/32″ brake line to Ø8-5/8″ pipe — with all-electric and hybrid machines, stacked tools, boosters and automation for series production. Send us the part drawing and the tube and we quote the right machine from either range.

faq.q: What do you need from me to quote tooling?
faq.a: Six things: material type, tube or profile size, wall thickness, the smallest centreline radius (CLR) you bend, the maximum bend angle and the maximum tube length. Every bender comes with one die set in the size you request; extra sets, ball mandrels and wiper dies are quoted from the same list.

faq.q: What voltage do the benders run on?
faq.a: Three-phase machines are supplied for 600 V as standard with a CSA-approved panel; 208 V, 240 V and 480 V 3-phase are available on request, and 240 V single-phase on the BK-42 and other models whose main motor is 2.2 kW (3 HP) or less — a machine with a motor above 2.2 kW must run on three-phase power and cannot be converted to 240 V single-phase.
